report.answer_text:
The U.S. federal government shutdown lasted 43 calendar days, from October 1 through November 12, 2025, counting the day it ended. The Congressional Research Service counts 42 full days of lapsed funding, through November 11. (oig.dol.gov)
It ended on the evening of November 12, when President Donald Trump signed H.R. 5371 into law. The Senate had approved the funding package 60–40 on November 10, and the House passed it 222–209 on November 12. The law restored funding for most of the government through January 30, 2026, and provided full-year funding for three of the twelve regular appropriations bills. (clickorlando.com)
